language.label: Language
setup.rail.label: Setup progress
setup.lede: A pigeon that watches a folder and carries every new photo home to Google Photos.
setup.walk.lede: Photo Pigeon opens each screen in your browser and waits here for you.
setup.welcome.own: Setup is five screens in your browser, most of them one button. You end up with your own Google Cloud project, which means your own daily upload quota that nobody else shares, and credentials that live only on this machine.
setup.welcome.oneDirection: Nothing is ever deleted. Photo Pigeon uploads, in one direction, and that is the whole of it. It cannot read your existing library and it cannot remove anything from it. There is no code in it that could.
setup.mascot.alt: The Photo Pigeon mascot, a pigeon holding a camera
setup.autostart.note: Photo Pigeon starts with Windows, so a backup tool that is meant to be running is running. You can turn this off any time from the tray menu.
setup.autostart.unavailable: Starting with Windows is a Windows feature and this build cannot set it from here. The tray menu has the same tick.
setup.smartscreen.heading: The blue box Windows showed
setup.smartscreen.line: If Windows put up a blue box before this app opened, that was SmartScreen noticing that Photo Pigeon is not signed by a big publisher yet, and More info then Run anyway is the way through it.
setup.smartscreen.diagram: Diagram of the SmartScreen box: a dialog with More info first and Run anyway second
setup.drop.label: Drag the downloaded JSON file here
setup.drop.watching: Watching your Downloads folder. If the file lands there, Photo Pigeon picks it up on its own.
setup.unverified.heading: The page Google shows once
setup.unverified.line: The first time you sign in, Google shows a full page saying it has not verified this app, and the way through is Advanced and then the link underneath it.
setup.unverified.diagram: Diagram of Google's unverified app page: click Advanced first, then the link underneath
setup.answer.lost: That answer did not reach the wizard
setup.answer.reopen: {why} Close this window and open setup again to pick up the walk.
setup.answer.stillWaiting: That answer did not reach the wizard. This is the question it is still waiting on.
setup.signing.line: Your browser has the sign in now. Photo Pigeon waits here until it is finished, and then it starts watching.
setup.written.title: Finish in your browser
setup.postmark.label: A postmark reading Photo Pigeon, delivered
setup.done.title: Photo Pigeon is ready
setup.done.lede: Signed in, and your credentials work.
setup.done.line: Photo Pigeon is set up and signed in.
setup.done.signedIn: Signed in. The pigeon starts watching now.
setup.done.text: Anything already in your watched folders goes on the first pass. The pigeon lives in the notification area.
setup.done.textWithLedger: Anything already in your watched folders goes on the first pass. The record of everything delivered lives at {ledgerPath}. You can close this window: the pigeon lives in the notification area.
setup.overflow.heading: Where the pigeon went
setup.overflow.line: Windows 11 tucks new tray icons into the hidden flyout, so click the small arrow at the left of the clock and drag the pigeon down onto the bar to keep it in sight.
setup.overflow.diagram: Diagram of the Windows 11 tray overflow: open the arrow, then drag the pigeon onto the taskbar
setup.diagram.windows: A diagram, not a screenshot of Windows.
setup.diagram.google: A diagram, not a screenshot of Google.
setup.failed: Setup did not finish. Nothing was written.
status.session.heading: This session
status.session.note: Counted since this copy started, not since you installed it.
status.watching.heading: Watching
status.watching.empty: The engine has not said what it watches yet.
status.watching.confirm: Stop watching this folder? Nothing is deleted from your disk and nothing is removed from Google Photos. New photos here simply stop being sent.
status.watching.unexplained: That did not change anything, and this build could not tell why.
status.watching.busy: Still working on the last change. One moment, then try again.
status.recent.heading: Recently
status.autostart.note: Photo Pigeon starts with Windows, so a backup tool that is meant to be running is running. Turning it off leaves everything else alone.
status.autostart.unavailable: Starting with Windows is a Windows feature and this build cannot set it from here.
health.title: Health
health.lede: Three of Google's quieter rules end small uploaders, and all three are invisible until they bite. This is the same check the command line runs.
health.checks.heading: What the check found
health.checks.empty: The health check had nothing to say.
health.footer: A console link on a row is text to copy. Photo Pigeon opens links from its own process and never from this window.
health.summary.fixLede: Each row below says what it is and what fixes it.
health.summary.watchLede: Nothing is broken. These are the ones that bite later.
health.summary.okLede: This is the same check the command line runs.
health.error.title: The check did not run
health.error.lede: Photo Pigeon could not start its own engine to ask.
